title: Frequently Asked Questions
subtitle: Answers to the most common questions we get from Tampa Bay homeowners.

items.q: How do I get an estimate?
items.a: Fill out the quote form on our Contact page or call us directly. We'll schedule a free on-site visit within 1–2 business days.
Yes. We are fully licensed by the State of Florida (License #CGC-000000) and carry general liability insurance. We can provide certificates on request.

items.q: How long does a typical project take?
items.a: It depends on the scope. A room repaint takes 1–2 days. A bathroom remodel typically takes 1–2 weeks. We give you a realistic timeline before we start and keep you updated throughout.
For projects over $2,000 we typically require a 30% deposit to schedule and secure materials. The balance is due upon completion.
Yes. For any work that requires a permit under Florida building code, we handle the permitting process. We never skip permits — it protects you as a homeowner.

items.q: Do you serve areas outside Tampa?
items.a: Yes. We serve the greater Tampa Bay area including St. Petersburg, Clearwater, Brandon, Wesley Chapel, Land O' Lakes, and surrounding areas. Call us if you're unsure.

items.q: Can you work with Spanish-speaking clients?
items.a: Absolutely. Our owner is bilingual. We're happy to communicate fully in Spanish.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a: We accept cash, check, Zelle, and major credit cards. Payment terms are included in your written estimate.
